title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park on 1969-07-12

ai_review.summary: Sweet jam from the NY State Pavilion with a recording hailed as “the cream of the world’s fair crop”.
ai_review.review: The reviewer paints a vivid picture of the second gig at Queens College’s NY State Pavilion, noting the unique rotunda acoustics and lack of noise complaints. While no specific musical details are given, the recording is praised enthusiastically, suggesting it captures the performance very well.
